$comment: Pinned local copy of the CMR hub's cmr.module/v1 schema (issue #1163). Source: kushin77/CMR vendor/CMR/catalog/schemas/module.schema.json at the submodule gitlink b6c49aa03992dba9fe4b87b46104b8fc2f69f224, the bundle_ref recorded in this repository's cmr-pin.yaml. Byte-identical to that file apart from this $comment, which is an annotation and has no validation effect. It exists so scripts/check-module-manifest.sh has a real schema input offline: a git worktree add does not initialise the submodule, and a validator that silently skips when its schema is missing is the formality #1163 is about. The vendored path is preferred whenever it is readable; this copy is the fallback, and its absence is CANNOT-ASSESS, never a pass.
title: CMR Module Manifest (v1)
description: Canonical schema for a governed module in the CMR hub-and-spoke ecosystem, ratifying the module.json draft from ARCHITECTURE §3.2. Ratified by ADR-0003. The manifest `schema` field carries the version identity `cmr.module/v1`; schema evolution happens via a new ADR, never silently. Extensible by ADR-0007: required core fields are closed, extension fields (description, epic, scope, etc.) are allowed. `type` enum extended with `governance` by ADR-0007 amendment (DR-009).

schema.title: Manifest schema version
schema.description: Version identity of this manifest. Must be exactly `cmr.module/v1` for v1.

id.title: Module id
id.description: Namespaced module id: lowercase, dot-separated segments of `a-z`, `0-9`, and `-`. Globally unique across the catalog (e.g. `erp-crm.rbac`).

type.title: Module type
type.description: Taxonomy type (R5): what kind of governed unit this module is.

source.title: Source repository
source.description: Where the module's code lives (provenance, R3/R10).

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: Default branch of the source repository (e.g. `main`).

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Version identity. The `vX.Y.Z` git tag is the source of truth (ADR-0002).

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description: Hybrid distribution info (ADR-0002, R15): language-native package and/or Terraform module. NOTE: this is the hybrid-package axis — the SaaS copy-out mode is `export_eligibility` below (ADR-0010), a distinct axis.

terraform.title: Terraform module
terraform.description: Terraform module registry/ref for IaC modules, or `null`.

license.title: License
license.description: Declared license of the module (SPDX id or `none`). For machinery eligible for SaaS copy-out this is recorded in the export ledger and granted at export time (SAAS-003 / ADR-0010 guard #6).

export_eligibility.title: SaaS export eligibility
export_eligibility.description: SaaS copy-out mode (ADR-0010 / docs/SAAS-BOUNDARY.md): `private` (default) = never crosses; `export-eligible` = machinery eligible for a licensed copy-out; `public-copy` = only valid in a DESTINATION org, never in the hub. The catalog validator rejects a hub module marked `public` or `public-copy` (the flip-over the boundary forbids).

features.title: Features
features.description: Capabilities consumers can toggle on/off individually (R6 selective consumption).

default.title: Default state
default.description: Default on/off for consumers that do not override.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: Config/env flag keys that gate this feature (e.g. `rbac.enabled`).

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connectors to external systems (R6): GHL, Google Workspace, Stripe, OIDC, etc.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Other modules this module depends on, pinned by SemVer range (R7).

module.title: Dependency module
module.description: Namespaced id of the dependency module.

consumers.title: Consumers
consumers.description: Module ids that consume this module; populated by the sync engine.

governance.title: Governance
governance.description: Governance profile applied to this module (declared in Terraform, applied by CI on merge).

harvested_from.title: Harvested from
harvested_from.description: Source repo/path the asset was harvested from, or `null` when not harvested.
